title: Crossposted from High Strangeness
content: My “mall” is attached to a high-end hotel. I am trying to get back to the hotel from where I parked in the underground garage. I know if I go through the department store (like a Macy’s) it will bring me to the elevator which goes to the hotel. Unfortunately, the escalators in the mall don’t go to the Macy’s from the underground garage. So I have to find the elevator. I hate this elevator. I’m waiting with a bunch of people and I know I’m not going to get on in the first bunch. I’m late, I need to get to the hotel. I see another elevator with fewer people waiting to get on. I go over there. I get on with the other people. The doors close and I realize this elevator doesn’t go to the “Macy’s.” I keep asking people where the store is. No one knows. These people are going to their offices in the mall, not the stores. Once everyone gets off, I punch the top button (unmarked, of course) hoping it will lead to the store. The elevator starts racing up; it’s too fast. Then it starts moving to the right, still going too fast. I start to panic. Finally the doors open and I’m on what appears to be the storage area of the mall. I step out, doors close behind me, and I am in a dusty, neglected place. I turn around to go back to the elevator and it’s gone. But wait! I see stairs! I can go back to ground level on them. I start down the stairs only to find I’m in kind of an Escher staircase world. It’s very hard to negotiate my way down but I manage. I see a door and open it. I’m back in the parking garage! I decide to just go back to my car and leave. My car is nowhere to be found. I go up each level by foot, no car, no doors. I usually wake myself up at this point. A different version on this dream: I’m still trying to get to the hotel. I’m inside the mall (Yay) and enter the department store. I have to go through all the departments: clothing, perfume, etc., and I know I’m getting closer to the hotel. I exit the store. A Japanese restaurant is to my right and I know I have to go through there to get to the hotel. They seem to recognize me and ask me to come in to eat. I thank them but tell them I have to get to the hotel. They take me behind the kitchen where there are stairs which they say will lead to the hotel. I feel like I’m getting close to the hotel but I still have to go through two or three more restaurants. Finally, I arrive at the hotel lobby. I go to the elevators (oh, no…not again) to get to my room and go through the same issues as the previous dream. But finally I get off at what appears to be my floor. I open the door to “my room” and see it is occupied by someone else. The other person is in the bathroom taking a shower. Instead of being upset that someone else is in my room, I panic and leave the room. Guess what? No way out. No stairs. No elevator. I wake myself up. Mostly what I get from these dreams is a sense of frustration and anxiety. I have them frequently enough to attempt to “change” them lucidly but I just have to wake myself up to exit this dreamscape.
